text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is amazing! To think you 
scouted such a star-studded cast!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that you have a real knack 
for producing stage shows?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need to be humble. 
Because, look――just listen closely, won't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Can't you hear it? The voices of the 
crowd roaring for your tactical 
direction."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go for the curtain call! Take 
everyone's hand. Come, the curtain rises!
